newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold steady, silver eases on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold steady, silver eases on profit-taking.

text.p: ** Gold 24 carat closes steady at 4,775 rupees per 10 gramme as restricted inflow matches demand.
** Gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) closes steady at 55,800 rupees per piece after a gain of 100 rupees on Wednesday.
** Silver (.999) closes five rupees lower at 6,875 rupees per kg on light profit-taking.
Gold 24 carat closed steady at 4,775 rupees per 10 gramme amid limited activity on Thursday as sluggish seasonal buying matched restricted supply, dealers said.
Gold rose 15 rupees per 10 gramme on Wednesday.
"Fresh offerings too remained low today following reports of uptrend in the world market," a dealer said.
Gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) closed steady at 55,800 rupees per piece after gaining 100 rupees on Wednesday.

Silver (.999) closed five rupees lower at 6,875 rupees per kg against the previous close of 6,880 rupees as sluggish industrial demand prompted light profit-taking at the higher levels. Silver was up by five rupees per kg on Wednesday.
"Local prices may bounce back again if fresh buying comes in," a broker said.
